en:
I'm Tomoharu Hosoda, a second-year.
You're {a}, right?
Before we start, I have a favor to ask.
I'd like you to keep my name out of the article.
If you can't promise me that, I can't tell this story.
Okay?{p}Will you keep me anonymous?
Keep him anonymous
Publish his name
Secretly name him in the article

Has anyone here ever explored the forbidden space in our school?
...Looks like nobody's raising a hand.
Well, I guess that's only natural.
That place is really bad news.
Huh? Which place am I talking about?
That would be.....................a toilet.
And not just any toilet.{p}
It's the toilet that won't flush.{p}

Well...?
Just hearing that, you can imagine how terrifying this toilet is.
You rush into a stall in a hurry.
And then, once you've finished your business, the toilet won't flush...
That kind of panic is like nothing else, right?
It must feel exactly like seeing heaven and hell all at once.{p}

That restroom is pretty famous, you know.
It's claimed a lot of victims in the past.
Most people who go in there end up feeling sick and get sent to the nurse's office.
After a while, once they're feeling better, they're the ones who have to clean the toilet that won't flush.
Why does everyone who uses that toilet get sick?
At first, I figured they felt sick from panicking when the toilet wouldn't flush.
But the reason wasn't that simple.{p}

This was just the other day.
Hino came to me with his plan for this seven wonders meeting.
He said he wanted me to present that report on the forbidden restroom he'd been asking me for.
Honestly, I wasn't too keen on it.
A terrifying, unnatural aura always hung around that restroom.{p}

Well, there are lots of ghost stories about restrooms, and plenty of restrooms have an aura.
But for some reason, that was the one restroom I didn't want to go to.
An aura that keeps you away... I guess you could call it that.
I could feel it so strongly it hurt.
But the request came from none other than Hino.
So I decided to explore the forbidden restroom.
Of course, before I went there, I made sure to do my business in a different restroom.
I didn't want to become a victim of the toilet that won't flush.{p}

And so, one day after school, I went to the toilet that won't flush.
It was filled with an overwhelming aura.
First, I peeked into the stalls one by one.
One of the toilets was giving off an especially strong aura.{p}

...I was sure that bowl was the toilet that won't flush.
I searched the stall all over, but there was nothing especially suspicious.
I could feel an overwhelming aura, but I couldn't tell where it was coming from.
So I decided to try squatting down over the toilet for a bit.
...Sorry, it's a weird thing to talk about.
Suddenly, I felt an overwhelming aura behind me.
It felt like someone was staring right at me.{p}

"Who's there?"
I muttered it without thinking, but nobody answered me.{p}

I stayed there with my head down for a while, feeling that aura.
...I see. So this is how everyone ended up feeling sick.
That's what I thought right away.
Even so, an aura that strong, and I couldn't see anything?
I couldn't believe it.
Just then, I suddenly heard a voice from behind me.
"Wrong..."
What was wrong?{p}

I turned around one more time.
But sure enough, there was nobody there.
"You can't see me, can you?
...Nobody can."
I heard a sad voice.
"And when I touch people, nobody notices.
It's the same with you, right?
...See, I'm touching your shoulder right now.
You can't tell, can you?"{p}

A chilly sensation spread across my shoulder.
"I-I can tell..."
That's what I answered.
So there really was a ghost in the forbidden toilet that won't flush.
I decided to find out more about this ghost.
"This aura hanging in the restroom is yours, isn't it?
Why are you giving off such a powerful aura?"
"...I can't leave this place.
More importantly, I have to find that guy."
"What guy?"
"I don't even know his name.
I don't know his face, either.
But I have to find him..."
"Then how are you supposed to find him?"{p}

"I have to find him..."
After saying that, the voice went silent.{p}

The next day after school, I reported to Hino.
I told him there was the ghost of a man in the forbidden restroom.
"That's amazing, Hosoda.
You've got to find out who that man really is.
Man, I knew you'd pull it off."
"Yes, I'm heading to that restroom again today."
Hino looked really pleased.
With that much riding on me, there was no backing out now, right?{p}

Besides, the ghost in the forbidden restroom sounded so lonely.
I thought maybe I wouldn't mind being his friend.
I mean, he didn't seem like a bad guy.{p}{a}, do you think that's strange?
Yes, I do
No, I don't

...Thank you.
I think you and I could be good friends, too.{p}

I headed for the forbidden restroom.
When I went into that stall, I heard the voice again.{p}

"Wrong..."
The ghost said the same thing again.
"What exactly is wrong?"
When I asked, he said this:
"You're not the man I'm looking for..."{p}

"A man? Who are you looking for?"
"......"
"Why are you looking for this man?"
"I don't know. I don't know. I don't know anything..."{p}

Suddenly, the stall door flew open.
A strong wind blew through the restroom.
My legs gave out from under me.
I couldn't move for a while.{p}

"I don't know, I don't know, I don't know..."
The ghost said it like it was tearing him apart.
I couldn't bear it.
I wanted so badly to help him.{p}

"Hey, isn't it impossible to find someone when you don't know who they are?"
I shouted as hard as I could so the wind wouldn't drown me out.{p}

"It's not impossible. I'll never forget the sight of his back..."
That's what he said.{p}

...So here's what it came down to.
The ghost remembered a certain man from behind.
And he was searching for that man.
He didn't even know why.
I promised I'd help him look.{p}

"...Thank you.
Then from now on, will you watch the backs of the people who come into this restroom, too?"
"Hold on a second.
I don't want to spy on people using the toilet.
Besides, you might not know this, but this place is called the forbidden restroom.
Hardly anyone ever comes here, right?
This is a bad place to look for someone."
"But I can't leave here."
"Why not?"
"I don't know..."{p}

Why couldn't he leave the restroom?
I wanted to get to the bottom of it.
So I decided to look around a little.
There didn't seem to be anything unusual about the stall.
There was no graffiti on the walls, and there was water in the toilet bowl, the way there should be.{p}
...I stared at the toilet and thought.
Examine the toilet more closely
Stick my hand in the toilet
Clean it
Pray to it
Check if something's clogging it

"I remember now.
That's my little sister...☆"
...Something cold touched me around the neck.
He had put his hand there.
It felt eerily real, and I spun around with a start.{p}

...I could see his spirit body clearly.
Maybe because he'd remembered what it was like when he was alive.
Then a cold wind blew against the nape of my neck.
It seemed to be his breath.
I heard him panting... hah... hah... like he was in pain.
He seemed terribly worked up.{p}

"I hate... I hate..."
He started saying things like that.
"What do you hate?
Do you hate your sister?"
"I hate... I hate...☆"
The voice got even louder.
His emotions must have been running really high.
He just kept saying "I hate" over and over, and he wouldn't answer me.{p}

Then the restroom door and windows started to rattle.{p}Spirit rapping, I guess you'd call it.
It was incredibly violent.
Talk it out
Run away

I decided to retreat for the time being.
I left the stall right away and went out into the hallway.{p}

The next day, when I went to the forbidden restroom, there was no sign of the ghost.
Where could he have gone?
I searched all kinds of restrooms around the school.
But I couldn't find out where he'd gone.
Then a thought struck me.{p}

That meant the search area got a lot bigger.
I searched all over the place during breaks and after school.{p}

When I went into the forbidden restroom, I felt a chill touch me from behind.
...It was him.
"Hosoda, I remember everything now."
His voice was quiet.
"So, I have a favor to ask..."
If he'd still been alive, he would have been drenched in clammy sweat.
That was the feeling he gave off.
"You're the only one I can ask to do something like this."
That's what he said.
And then he told me the whole story.
It was something that happened about two years ago.{p}

The car that did it was one that took a student at our school to and from school.
It seems some students got a ride to school by car now and then.
What he saw as he was hit was the back of a student in our uniform, inside the car as it drove away.
Inoue decided he would find out who that student was.{p}

Of course, he knew full well that he could never actually do that.
What he wanted was for the driver, and the student too, to mourn his sister's death and atone for it.{p}

Inoue went around to all sorts of classes and started making a list of the students who were driven to and from school by car.
Once the list was done, he meant to look at each of them from behind and make sure.
But the student in question didn't just sit back and watch him do it.
That guy... poisoned Inoue.
Inoue stayed behind alone until late every day, digging into it, you see.
To the culprit, he must have been an easy target.{p}
One day after school, when Inoue stepped away from his seat for a moment, that guy slipped poison into the juice Inoue had been drinking.{p}

As soon as Inoue drank the juice, a wave of nausea hit him.
So he ran into the nearest restroom.{p}

He collapsed onto the floor and writhed in pain.
No one came to help him.
It hurt so much he couldn't even stand up.
It was hopeless.
While all that was going on, his pass case fell out of his pocket.
The very one I found in the toilet that won't flush.{p}

The one with his sister's photo in it.
Inoue had been throwing up with the toilet flushing nonstop, so the pass case got flushed away.
It got stuck in there, and that's why that toilet stopped flushing.
Once you've heard all this, you can see why the people who used it got sick, one after another.{p}

After all, that's the toilet where he was poisoned and died in agony.
He breathed his last in under ten minutes.
Afterward, it seems the culprit got rid of the body.
Inoue ended up listed as missing.{p}

When he'd finished telling me all this, he came out with something.
"Hosoda.
I found the culprit.
So I have a favor to ask.
I want you to kill the one who killed my sister and me.
I can never forgive him.
You understand, right?
It's the only way left.
I can't touch people.
I can't even hold things.
No matter how I struggle, I can't kill that guy on my own..."
The chilly touch on my shoulder grew colder and colder.
At the same time, I felt a cold breath on me.
It felt awfully real.{p}So what do you think I did?
Accept
I can't do that

"I see...
Yeah, of course.
Killing someone isn't something you can just go and do, is it?
Then how about this?
Could you bring him to this restroom?
If you do that, I'll take care of the rest..."
Inoue fixed me with a clammy, clinging stare.{p}
Agree
Refuse

The cold touch that had been on my shoulder moved to my neck.
"Hosoda, can you tell where my hand is right now?"
When I put my hand to my neck, Inoue let out a deep sigh.
"Yeah.
...That's right.
Don't worry.
I'm not going to strangle you or anything.
Hosoda, just stay like this and listen.
Today I went to my house.
To see how my parents were doing.
Dad wasn't there, he was at work.
Mom was alone, doing the household accounts and tapping her shoulders.
My mom has terrible stiff shoulders.
So I tried to give her a shoulder rub.
I kneaded her shoulders, stroked her back, and tried to loosen up her neck.{p}

...Mom didn't notice.
She just kept rolling her shoulders like they hurt.
I guess people without a sixth sense can't feel it.
Hey, Hosoda.
I can't even do that much now.
So..."
Inoue's hand stayed cold through and through.
"I can't do it alone.
Please, you have to understand.
We're friends, aren't we?"{p}

When I heard those words, a shock ran through my heart.
After he'd said that much, I couldn't turn him down.
...I'd lost.
I did as he told me and called that student to the forbidden restroom.{p}

The guy's name was Nagamine.
Getting him there was easy.
I wrote him a letter.
"I know about what happened two years ago.
I need to talk to you about it.
Please come to the restroom, you know the one." That's what I wrote.{p}

He came.
He was a small guy.
So meek-looking that I wondered if someone like him could ever kill anyone...
"Please!
Keep this a secret☆"
Nagamine said that to me right off the bat.
"My dad ran someone over, and I didn't know what to do.
That's why I did that...
Dad said he'd turn himself in, but I couldn't agree to it.
What have I done?
But..."{p}

"If this gets out, my family is finished.
I know it's unforgivable.
But please, I'm begging you.
Don't tell anyone☆"
I didn't know what to do, so I just stood there frozen.{p}

Just then, Inoue's hand, resting on my shoulder from behind, grew colder and colder.
No.
Inoue, stop☆
I wanted to say it, but my voice wouldn't come out.{p}

The cold seeped into my shoulder.
It felt like jelly squelching its way inside me.
Inoue's cold breath blew on the nape of my neck.
Before long, even that breath was slowly seeping inside me.
I felt like I was going to freeze to death.
...When I came to, I was strangling Nagamine, the boy who'd covered for his father.
It wasn't my will.
Inoue had possessed me.
It wasn't my fault.
I'm not to blame.
{a}, we're friends, right?
You believe me, don't you?{p}

...I kept on strangling him.
Soon, white, bubbly froth oozed out at the corners of his lips.
He made noises that weren't words, like 'gwagh' and 'glurk.'
He died fast.
He went limp and collapsed.
I was dragged down with him and dropped to my knees on the floor.
My hands had locked stiff around his neck, still strangling him, you see.
...After a while, I slowly became able to move my body again.
And then I heard Inoue's voice.{p}

I buried it behind the school.
I never want to go through anything like that again.{p}

...{a}.
Why are you shaking?
I told you, didn't I? I'm not to blame...
So please don't put my name in the paper.
I don't want to get caught by the police.
Huh? What happened to the forbidden restroom after that?{p}

...I hear it still won't flush.
Well, of course it won't, right?
Another murder happened in there...
I don't want to go anywhere near that restroom anymore, so I haven't actually checked, though.
...I don't want to be the next victim.{p}

I haven't told Hino how this all ended.
{a}.
I'd like you to be the one to pass this story on to him.{p}That's the end of my story.
Next is the third one, huh?
I'm looking forward to a good story.{p}

That's awful.
I can't tell my story like that.{p}

{a}.
You've got a look on your face like you're scheming something.
I don't like that kind of thing.
I don't know what you're thinking, though.
...Um, first, let me ask all of you something.{p}

And of course, {a}, you and I are friends now too.
You seem like a nice person, after all.
Right? Isn't that so?
...Oh, sorry.
Let me get back to the story.{p}

Staring at the toilet, I tried to sense the aura.
...I could feel a strong aura.
But that was all.
That stall had been full of an incredible aura from the start, you see.
I couldn't really tell whether the source of the aura was the toilet or not.{p}

I stuck my hand into the toilet.
The water inside was cold and slimy.
...It was disgusting.
Even remembering it now makes me feel sick.
That was when it happened.{p}

"Hosoda!
What are you doing?"
Hino had shown up.
"I just came by to see how things were going... That's a pretty bold investigation you're running."
"Er... well..."
Getting caught in such a weird pose was kind of embarrassing.{p}

"Hosoda, you're not pushing yourself too hard, are you?"
Hino peered into my face, looking worried.
"Just finding a male ghost is a good haul already.
There's still time before the seven wonders interviews.
Take your time looking into it."
...I felt a strong gaze from behind me.{p}

It was him.
He must have gotten angry when he learned I'd come for a report.
...But that's not true.
At first, the report was my goal, but by then I truly wanted to help him.{p}

Hino dragged me out of there by force.
Ever since then, the ghost has rejected me.{p}

I hear the forbidden restroom is still claiming victims.
The mystery of that restroom still hasn't been solved.
That's the end of my story.
{a}, please keep your promise.
Don't print my name.
I don't want everyone thinking I'm the kind of guy who lets his friends down...
I'm really counting on you.{p}So, whose turn is next?{p}

I decided to clean it.
I scrubbed the toilet with the toilet brush.
"Hosoda, why are you doing that?"
"Oh, no real reason..."
It was no good.
Making it clean wasn't going to change anything.{p}

That's it.
Maybe the toilet won't flush because something's clogging it.{p}

For lack of a better idea, I tried praying to it.
...Nothing happened.{p}

...Forget it.
I don't want to waste my time.{p}

"What's wrong? Calm down!"
I desperately tried talking to him.
But it was no use.
He was so worked up there was just no handling him.{p}

In the end, I decided to retreat for the time being.
I left the stall and went out into the hallway.{p}

...By the way, {a}.
You're actually planning to put my name in the article, aren't you?
You were acting strangely earlier, too.
If that's the case, this is as far as I can tell you.{p}

Huh? How did I do it, you ask?
Actually, I haven't killed him yet.
{a}, you see, once this story is in the paper, I want him to turn himself in.
If he does, I'm thinking I'll do him in a way that's a little less painful.
Listen, add this to the paper.
If you turn yourself in, I won't kill you.
So come forward as soon as you can.
The truth is, though, whether he turns himself in or not, I'm planning to send him to the next world.{p}

I mean, it's only fair, right?
He did something horrible.
He deserves at least that much payback, don't you think?
Let me make sure once more: you can't write my name.
If it got out that this plan was mine, who's to say he wouldn't kill me instead?
That's right, I could lose, too.
When I face him, he might fight dirty and kill me.{p}

If that happens... you'll have to avenge me.
I mean, we're friends too, aren't we...?
Right, {a}?
If you don't, I might hold a grudge and come back to haunt you.{p}

Come on, don't make that face.
It's okay, I'm not going to die.
If I died, everyone would be sad.
And of course, you'd be really sad too.{p}Well, time to hand it over to the next person.
What kind of story will it be this time?{p}

"Thank you..."
The cold hand resting on my shoulder was trembling slightly.
"Actually, today I went to my house.
To see how my parents were doing.
Dad wasn't there, he was at work.
Mom was alone, doing the household accounts and tapping her shoulders.
My mom has terrible stiff shoulders.
So I tried to give her a shoulder rub.
I kneaded her shoulders, stroked her back, and tried to loosen up her neck.
...Mom didn't notice.
She just kept rolling her shoulders like they hurt.
I guess people without a sixth sense can't feel it..."{p}
